role: Generator: writes the recipe registry as a C header (csrc/engine/recipes.h): CraftingManager.getRecipeList() in list order (shaped, shapeless, special IRecipe classes by simple name) and FurnaceRecipes smelting and experience tables, read off the live objects.
used_by: make -C oracle run CLASS=RecipeTable CMD='{"out":...}' (regenerates csrc/engine/recipes.h)
notes: No dedicated make target like biomes-h was found in oracle/Makefile; the generic run target is assumed. csrc/engine/recipes.h names RecipeTable as its generator.
